items.title: Bioactive metabolites from an endophytic fungus inhibit azole-resistant Candida albicans
items.abstract: Bioassay-guided fractionation of an endophyte extract yielded a fraction with potent fungicidal activity against clinical azole-resistant isolates, with low cytotoxicity in human cell lines.

items.title: Synergistic interaction of a plant-derived phenolic with fluconazole against Candida biofilms
items.abstract: Checkerboard and time-kill assays revealed strong synergy (FICI ≤ 0.5) that restored fluconazole activity against biofilm-forming strains.

items.title: Down-regulation of CDR1 and ERG11 expression underlies the anticandidal action of a novel compound
items.abstract: qRT-PCR, sorbitol protection and ergosterol binding assays point to the fungal membrane as the primary target, with reduced efflux pump expression.

items.title: A stable topical nano-emulgel of an antifungal natural product: formulation and evaluation
items.abstract: An optimised nano-emulgel showed sustained release, six-month stability and superior ex vivo antifungal efficacy compared with a conventional gel.
